current_events: Poland's ambassador to Romania, Paweł Soloch, and ambassador to China, Jakub Kumoch, resign from their positions in protest of the suspension of Polish Constitutional Tribunal president Bogdan Święczkowski
Polish constitutional crisis, China–Poland relations, Poland–Romania relations

The Malagasy justice ministry reports that 13 Chinese-run scam centers linked to networks previously operating in Cambodia were dismantled and that 148 Chinese nationals were extradited to China. Officials say some African workers may have been trafficked and coerced into fraud
Trafficking of Chinese nationals to scam centers abroad, Human trafficking in Madagascar

A pregnant woman is shot dead and six others are injured in a Spirit Halloween store in Fairfield, Solano County, California, United States. Another person is shot and killed in another Spirit Halloween store near Detroit
Protests are held across France for the third consecutive weekend
Youth-led protests are held across 34 cities in Germany. The protests are against the rising cost of living, education sector issues, and opposition to military conscription
In thoroughbred horse racing, thoroughbred racehorse Sovereignty wins the Breeders' Cup classic at the Keeneland racetrack in Lexington, Kentucky, U.S
The 2026 Summer Youth Olympics opens in Dakar, Senegal, marking the first IOC event in Africa
